camera: Flat front-facing UI over a dimmed top-down painted region terrain map; no 3D previews or parallax.

hudLayout.topThird: Top-left: tilted brown leather chapter book with gold '1' and 'CHAPTER'. Top-right: grey header strip with three dark grey counter slots: hexagonal gold coin 0, green star 0, magenta meeple 121; a 4-segment quest bar below, the first segment green-filled and two grey, with '0/4' in amber. On the dark wood plank band below: left a gold-khaki 'CLAIM BOUNTY' button with a green star icon; centre a rolled parchment quest scroll with red wax seal; right a khaki 'COLLECT RAT TAILS' quest card with a pink rat-tail icon and a progress bar '20/50'. At ~17% the 'LOCAL FARM' tab with farmhouse icon and red badge '2', and four locked dark tabs with black silhouettes. From ~20% the Local Farm region terrain map with an empty grey card slot at centre.
hudLayout.middleThird: A large square lime-olive reward panel spanning ~85% of width from ~31% to ~69% height, with a darker olive bottom lip and a notch at bottom-right. In its centre at ~47% a large glossy green star XP icon with a bright highlight. Behind the panel, dimmed: henchman card at the left edge, carrot slot '29' with badge '1' and the teal 'MAX HIRE' button at the right edge.
hudLayout.bottomThird: Inside the lower part of the panel at ~65%: 'Tap to collect 25 XP!' in large pale-lime bold text. Below the panel an empty dark navy area to ~94%. Bottom strip: dark wood plank band with a steel-blue cog at bottom-right; debug text 'fps: 60.02' bottom-left and 'username' bottom-centre. Everything except the panel is dimmed by a dark overlay.
